Status: wave 344: the three en methods that format exactly one device-info property

Method.evidence: en::.cctor registers display formatters either as <>c lambdas or as ordinary en methods (formatter shape String(object, Class430, IDataProvider, IDictionary<ResourceName, byte[]>)). Three methods format exactly one property and are named Format<Property>: FormatDeviceOrderId (0x060000DA), FormatApplicationId (0x060000DF), FormatCouplServControl (0x060000E4).
Method.themes: Four further method formatters are shared across properties (0x060000D9 for 4, 0x060000DB for 2, 0x060000E2 for 3, 0x060000E3 for 3), so they are generic renderers and need their bodies read (en::c already proved to be a 6-byte address hex formatter from its literal in an earlier turn).
